cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When you say you heard about the party, which part? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then carry my train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then carry my train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sign says no tasting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll make an announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already bought tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already bought tickets.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.
